# iDNES — Czech contemporary review

- Original source: [iDNES — Czech contemporary review](https://www.idnes.cz/hry/recenze/robin-hood-legend-of-sherwood.A021116_robinhoodlegendofsherwood_bw)
- Author / publication: Tomáš Krajča / iDNES.cz
- Language / date: Czech; 2002-11-18, updated 2003-03-31
- Access: Article opening and campaign discussion inspected
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

Krajča describes a strongly favorable experience with both the demo and full release. The opening places the game in the lineage of Commandos and Desperados, while comparing complementary character abilities with the puzzle structure of Lost Vikings.

The reviewer admires the elaborate, almost cartoon-like visual detail and describes a campaign that allows some choice of story order and forest raids. His enthusiasm is framed as firsthand extended play.

This review complements the same author's walkthrough installments. Its stated campaign total should be interpreted using the author's counting convention; the excerpts inspected do not establish every possible conditional mission.
